payload.summary: nice-delirium: one work, two section URLs, one source id
payload.detail: The published dictionary uses the id nice-delirium for the NICE delirium guidance at one section URL; the 2026-09 handover proposes the same id at a different section URL. The existing identity is preserved and the handover URL recorded as an alternate locator rather than a second source, because minting a second id to make duplicate detection pass would split one work into two register entries. Owner to confirm which URL is canonical.
